## Evidence needed

Describe the physical device, bench setup, owner judgment, credential, or real-world
observation required.

## Agent preparation

List artifacts or instructions an agent may prepare before handoff.

## Human procedure

Include setup, safety precautions, expected limits, observations to record, and stop
conditions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Real evidence is recorded without exposing secrets or unnecessary personal data.
- [ ] Results include hardware, firmware, app, and instrument revisions.
- [ ] Failures and deviations create focused follow-up issues.
- [ ] The tracking issue and downstream readiness labels are updated.
